name: flat700_a
description: Levelled AI grid for class A (the standard of the career AI, A 700 version of flat800_s): the same 11 models of AIField_80090001, window 690..700 (the builder needs min < max; a player at 700 or above gives a target of exactly 700) and a 0..0 band in every frame, so every AI car loads the tune file at PI 700 (or its highest file below). Same layout template, difficulty and document flags as flat800_s (slow-down and catch-up on, proximity and position spread off). Target document AIField_659620013_Gen.xml: no override record cites it (free); its previous content was the japan_c pool of G21, whose series are not in the live cache.
